preconditions.description: Must be the contract owner to call deprecate() function
Attacker must have some USDT tokens to verify upgrade manipulation

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call deprecate() with a malicious upgradedAddress that implements UpgradedStandardToken interface. The malicious contract should override transferByLegacy, transferFromByLegacy, and approveByLegacy functions to allow arbitrary token transfers, enabling the attacker to steal funds from any user. After deprecation, all token operations will be routed through the malicious upgrade contract.
